category.description: spec-error/spec-missing are union-processed; direction-disagreement routes to the direction-review path; doc-drift is a real doc-vs-code mismatch; intentional marks a divergence covered by a drift-ok annotation. Enterprise audit categories map to the ten layer gate in paths/enterprise-audit-gate.json.

layer.description: Enterprise audit layer. Optional for non-enterprise profiles.

redline.description: True when the finding blocks the layer gate until fixed, falsified with evidence, or human-overridden.

evidence.description: Must be path:line or verbatim command output. Free-text LLM assertion does not qualify.

unsupported.description: Set true when evidence does not meet path:line or command-output standard. Auto-classified low severity.
